source.sourceRule: Only the already-consumed HY-EXP-0024 Development source and its locked manifest may be used; no Final OOS path may be read.

walkForward.trainingLabelRule: training signalTime is inside train window and labelEndTime <= validationStart - purgeBars*4h
walkForward.validationLabelRule: validation signalTime is inside validation window and labelEndTime < 2026-07-01T00:00:00.000Z

universe.eligibleSymbolDefinition: All eight fixed symbols with complete causal 4h/1h/5m/funding rows at the decision context

regime.btcFast: SMA of the last 60 completed BTCUSDT 4h closes including the latest completed bar
regime.btcSlow: SMA of the last 180 completed BTCUSDT 4h closes including the latest completed bar
regime.bull: btcFast > btcSlow AND latest BTCUSDT 4h close > btcSlow AND count(symbol close > each symbol SMA180) >= ceil(eligibleSymbols*2/3)
regime.decisionBoundary: Use the latest 4h bar whose closeBoundary <= the completed 1h signal bar close; never use a forming 4h bar

candidate.breakout: completed 1h close > max(high of the prior 120 completed 1h bars)

channelDistanceFeature.name: sideAdjustedPrior60ChannelDistanceOverATR20
channelDistanceFeature.atr20: 20-period true-range ATR on completed 1h bars, including the current completed signal bar
channelDistanceFeature.priorChannel: minimum(low of the prior 60 completed 1h bars), excluding current signal bar

q75Protocol.name: TRAINING_ONLY_EMPIRICAL_Q75
q75Protocol.population: qualifying BULL/BUY/TREND_BREAKOUT training rows with valid label and channel-distance feature
q75Protocol.algorithm: sort training feature values ascending; position=(n-1)*0.75; linearly interpolate adjacent values
q75Protocol.finalLiveRule: after Development PASS only, freeze Q75 calculated from the full allowed Development training set; never calculate it from live or Final OOS observations

edgeModel.target: gross directional price return bps before costs and funding
edgeModel.trainingRows: only rows passing the fold's training-only Q75 and satisfying the fold's purge rule
edgeModel.expectedPriceEdgeBps: arithmetic mean of training gross directional price return bps
edgeModel.standardErrorOfMeanBps: sample standard deviation of training gross returns divided by sqrt(n), with n-1 denominator
edgeModel.monthlyClusteredStandardErrorBps: sample standard deviation of UTC signal-month training means divided by sqrt(number of months); diagnostic only, null when fewer than two months
edgeModel.noPooledMeanAcrossCells: The only bucket is the fold-specific BULL/BUY Q75 bucket; no BEAR/SELL or pooled all-direction row may contribute

historicalDevelopment.entry: exact 5m contract-price bar open at theoreticalDecisionTime + 5 minutes
historicalDevelopment.adverseChannel: prior 60 completed 1h low, excluding current exit bar
historicalDevelopment.exit: ATR_STOP first; otherwise dynamic adverse channel exit after completed 1h close; otherwise terminal exit at the close of the sixth completed 1h holding bar

costs.historicalFunding: realized causal funding rows from the locked source; no forecast substituted for realized label funding

netEdgeGate.advisoryRequires: base Net Edge TRADE and Portfolio Risk Gate allowed

portfolioRisk.riskSizing: existing paper research risk layer only; no live quantity or order is emitted

developmentGates.failureAction: EXPERIMENTAL_RELEASE_READY=false; stop; do not lower Q75, minimum samples, uncertainty, 18/27bps costs, Net Edge thresholds or switch to secondary diagnostics

liveSignalPath.flow: GitHub Actions -> Vercel -> Binance public APIs -> BULL regime -> BUY breakout -> frozen training Q75 -> empirical bucket edge -> HENGYU-NET-EDGE-001 -> existing advisory layer -> Supabase -> Gmail
emailSafetyText: Entry, position size and exit are manually decided by the user.
